message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look “watch‑list” that spans classic chills, modern scares, and everything in between. Pick whatever fits your mood—whether you’re after a psychological thriller, a supernatural ghost story, or a straight‑up slasher.

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|-----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Psychological / Classic | Hitchcock’s masterclass in suspense; the shower scene is legendary. |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological / Supernatural | Kubrick’s eerie adaptation of Stephen King; the hallway fight is unforgettable. |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Slasher | The original John Carpenter slasher; Michael Myers’ silent menace still terrifies. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Supernatural | One of the most unsettling exorcism films ever made; the “demon’s hand” scene is iconic. |
| 5 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Psychological / Supernatural | A modern horror that blends family drama with creeping dread; the finale is mind‑bending. |
| 6 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social Thriller | Jordan Peele’s sharp satire wrapped in a chilling horror narrative. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Survival / Sci‑Fi Horror | Silence is the main weapon; the tension is palpable. |
| 8 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Supernatural / Modern | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope; the soundtrack is haunting. |
| 9 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Folk Horror | Daylight horror at its best; the cult rituals are disturbingly beautiful. |
|10 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Supernatural / Thriller | The cursed videotape concept is creepy; the ending is a shocker. |
|11 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological / Supernatural | A metaphorical look at grief that turns into a literal monster. |
|12 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑Horror | It plays with all the tropes and then flips them on their head. |
|13 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal Investigation | Based on real‑life investigators Ed & Lorraine Warren; the house scenes are tense. |
|14 | **Suspiria** (2018) | 2018 | Gothic / Psychological | Luca Guadagnino’s remake is visually stunning and unnervingly atmospheric. |
|15 | **The Others** | 2001 | Gothic / Psychological | Nicole Kidman’s performance and the twist make this a modern classic. |

### Quick Picks by Mood

| Mood | Suggested Film |
|------|----------------|
| **Classic chills** | *Psycho*, *The Shining* |
| **Modern psychological** | *Hereditary*, *Midsommar* |
| **Slasher nostalgia** | *Halloween*, *Friday the 13th* |
| **Social commentary** | *Get Out*, *Us* |
| **Family‑friendly fright** | *Coraline*, *ParaNorman* |
| **Supernatural thrill** | *The Conjuring*, *Annabelle* |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a deeper dive into any particular sub‑genre, or if you’re looking for something more obscure or indie‑style!
